title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Alexander Zverev and Ben Shelton in the ATP World Tour Finals, John McEnroe Group, originally scheduled for November 17, 2026 at 8:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Alexander Zverev' if Alexander Zverev advances against Ben Shelton.

This market will resolve to 'Ben Shelton' if Ben Shelton advances against Alexander Zverev.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by December 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
